subject.title: feat(plugin-sdk): add optional CliBackendPlugin.estimateUsage hook for text-output backends

question: Should OpenClaw add a public `CliBackendPlugin.estimateUsage` contract now, and must estimated usage be visibly distinguished from provider-reported usage before any backend can opt in?
rationale: The patch creates a compatibility-sensitive SDK surface whose permanent semantics and user-facing presentation cannot be selected safely by implementation review alone.

options.title: Approve a bounded estimated-usage contract
options.body: Define the public hook and required presentation semantics, then require this PR to include consumer coverage and real backend proof.

options.title: Defer the SDK addition
options.body: Keep the issue and PR open until a bundled or external backend demonstrates that the existing surfaces cannot satisfy the need.

options.title: Decline heuristic usage display
options.body: Close the direction if OpenClaw should continue showing only provider-supplied structured usage.

recommendation.title: Approve a bounded estimated-usage contract
recommendation.body: Define the public hook and required presentation semantics, then require this PR to include consumer coverage and real backend proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR identifies steipete as a requested reviewer for the linked API decision.
